item.title: Bose QuietComfort Headphones
item.description: High-fidelity audio and legendary noise cancellation. Toggle between Quiet and Aware Modes, or create a Custom Mode and adjust outside sound to the moment. Optional audio cable with in-line microphone for wired listening.

item.title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen)
item.description: Obsessively engineered with best noise cancellation and spatialized audio for immersive listening. Crafted with luxe materials for unrivaled comfort and premium design.

item.title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds
item.description: Cuff-like fit leaves ears totally open so you can still hear the world around you, while OpenAudio technology provides rich, private sound.

item.title: Bose QuietComfort Earbuds
item.description: The everyday, made epic. New Bose QuietComfort Earbuds offer iconic audio, renowned noise cancellation, and a relentless, long-lasting battery in a compact, durable package.

item.title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen)
item.description: The next-gen QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds with premium, personalized audio of CustomTune tech, best-in-ear noise cancellation, and comfortable fit.

item.title: Bose SoundLink Flex Portable Speaker (2nd Gen)
item.description: Updated SoundLink Flex Speaker with big, bold sound in a super-packable size, built durable for use anywhere.

item.title: Bose SoundLink Plus Portable Speaker
item.description: Big enough to bring the bass while still being portable, with bold, resonant audio and a tough, ready-for-anything exterior. Handle & Carrying Strap accessories sold separately.

item.title: Bose SoundLink Home Bluetooth Speaker
item.description: Standout sound from a size that fits in, with chic touches for a premium feel and sleek good looks. Wireless design for use in any room of the home.

item.title: Bose SoundLink Max Portable Speaker
item.description: Epic stereo sound and deep bass turn good times to the max, with compact design and removable handle for taking the party anywhere. Handle & Carrying Strap accessories sold separately.

item.title: Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar
item.description: Top-of-the-line soundbar with Dolby Atmos and Bose TrueSpace technology that separates instruments, dialogue, and effects for a truly immersive spatial audio experience. A.I. Dialogue Mode automatically balances voice and surround sound.

item.title: Bose Smart Soundbar
item.description: Delivers impressive immersion on its own; can pair with Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (sold separately) via Personal Surround Sound for amplified immersion without additional equipment.

item.title: Bose Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar
item.description: Built to bring immersive sound with Dolby Atmos. Proprietary PhaseGuide speakers project and reflect sound; QuietPort Technology delivers thunderous bass. Part of the Bose Lifestyle Collection, expandable into a home theater setup.

item.title: Bose Lifestyle Ultra Speaker
item.description: Powerful enough to drench any space in lush, clear audio and versatile enough to expand into a multiroom setup. Use solo or pair two for stereo. Use in concert with a Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and Subwoofer for dynamic surround sound.

item.title: Bose Lifestyle Ultra Subwoofer
item.description: The deepest, most powerful bass ever to deliver thunderous, immersive lows.

item.title: Bose Bass Module 500
item.description: Small sub with unmatched bass for its size to provide rich sound. Easy to set up. Connects wirelessly for easier placement.

item.title: Bose Surround Speakers
item.description: Add these small rear speakers to the Bose Soundbar 700 or Bose Soundbar 900 to feel like you're in the middle of everything you listen to or watch.

item.title: Bose Bass Module 700
item.description: The difference between hearing bass and feeling thunder starts the moment you add this wireless bass module to the Bose Soundbar 700 or Bose Soundbar 900.

item.title: Bose Soundbar Wall Bracket-kit
item.description: Mount your Bose soundbar to the wall with the Bose Soundbar Wall Bracket.

item.title: Bose UB-20 Series II Wall/Ceiling Bracket
item.description: Mount your Bose soundbar to the wall with the Bose Soundbar Wall Bracket.

item.title: BOYA BY-M1 Pro II Lavalier Microphone
item.description: Upgrade lavalier microphone (no battery needed), clip-on mic for smartphones, camcorders, DSLR, audio recorders, PC. Omnidirectional, selectable -10dB pad, switchable smartphone/camera mode, 3.5mm headphone jack.

item.title: BOYA BY-M1DM Dual Omnidirectional Lavalier Mic
item.description: Dual omnidirectional lavalier mic for smartphones, DSLR, camcorders, audio recorders, PC. Excellent for interviews, improved sensitivity and signal-to-noise.

item.title: BOYA BY-MM1 Universal Compact Microphone
item.description: Compact on-camera shotgun microphone, compatible with smartphones, DSLRs, consumer camcorders, PCs. Rugged metal construction, no battery required.

item.title: BOYA BY-M1000 Pro Large Diaphragm Studio Microphone
item.description: Large diaphragm XLR condenser microphone for podcast, voiceover, home studio recording. Gold-sputtered diaphragm, broadcast-quality, cardioid/omnidirectional/bidirectional patterns, off-axis rejection, included shockmount & pop filter, digital switching high-pass filter and -10dB pad.

item.title: BOYA BY-PM700 USB Microphone
item.description: USB microphone compatible with Windows and Mac computers. 16Bit/48kHz resolution, stereo/cardioid/omnidirectional/bidirectional polar patterns, triple-capsule design, mute function, 1/8 headphone monitoring jack.

item.title: BOYA K9 Condenser USB Microphone
item.description: Condenser USB microphone with Hi-Fi quality sound 48kHz/24-bit, innovative one-tap noise cancellation, 3 polar patterns (supercardioid, Figure-8, omnidirectional), RGB lighting with 3 vibrant effects, real-time monitoring via 3.5mm TRS.

item.title: BOYAMIC Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz dual-channel wireless mic, up to 300m wireless transmission, separate noise cancellation control (48kHz/24bit HD), 8GB memory (up to 15 hrs recording), windproof capsule, magnet attach, rotating fur windshield, OLED display, selectable mono/stereo/safety track, 3.5mm TRS/USB-C/iOS Lightning output, charging case included.

item.title: BOYAMIC 2 AI-Powered Mini Wireless Microphone
item.description: AI-powered mini wireless microphone. True AI noise cancellation up to 40dB, 90dB SNR, 2TX-4RX connection supports up to 8 devices, 32-bit float onboard REC with 8GB storage, AGC & limiter, sleek soundwave design, up to 300m transmission.

item.title: BOYALINK Wireless Microphone System
item.description: All-in-one design wireless microphone system with dual 2.4G channels. USB-C, Lightning and 3.5mm TRS connectors, all-in-one storage design, dual-channel wireless, easy-to-use setup, comes with 3 different adapters.

item.title: BOYALINK 2 Wireless Microphone
item.description: Upgraded 3-in-1 compact wireless microphone with 3 interchangeable adapters, full compatibility with cameras/mobile/computers, 2-level noise cancellation, up to 300m line-of-sight range, MFi-certified, 48kHz 24-bit studio-quality sound, up to 30 hours battery life.

item.title: BOYALINK 3 AI-Powered Button-Sized Wireless Microphone
item.description: AI-powered button-sized wireless microphone. True AI noise cancellation up to 40dB, 85dB SNR HIFI sound, AGC/limiter/safety track, 2TX-4RX supports up to 8 devices, discreet 9g button-sized mic with dustproof grille, customizable EQ tuning, up to 300m range.

item.title: BOYA BY-WM4 Pro-K2 Dual-Channel Wireless Microphone Kit
item.description: Dual-channel digital wireless microphone kit consisting of two body-pack transmitters and a portable receiver. Super-clear recording sound, master volume control, up to 84dB signal/noise ratio, headphone jack for real-time monitoring, up to 60m operation range, powered by two AAA batteries.

item.title: BOYA BY-WM8 Pro-K2 UHF Dual-Channel Wireless Microphone Kit
item.description: UHF dual-channel wireless microphone system with two transmitters and one receiver. Easy-to-read LCD display, 48 selectable channels, broadcast-quality sound, selectable stereo/mono mode, headphone monitoring, up to 100m operation range, ideal for interviews, broadcast, EFP, ENG.

item.title: BOYA BY-XM6-S2 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz dual-channel wireless microphone system, 2 transmitters + 1 receiver. Ideal for two-person vlog, YouTube video, live streaming, interview, recording. Hi-Fi low-noise audio, OLED display, built-in Li-ion batteries (7h TX, 6.5h RX), up to 100m range.

item.title: BOYA BY-XM6-K2 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz adaptive frequency hopping wireless microphone system, 2 transmitters + 1 receiver + charging case. Ideal for two-person vlog, YouTube video, live streaming, interview, recording. Double the working hours with charging case.

item.title: BOYA BY-V1 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz wireless microphone for iOS devices (Lightning). Omnidirection built-in mic for 360-degree sound pickup, ultra compact receiver, selectable noise cancellation, up to 9 hours operation time.

item.title: BOYA BY-V10 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz wireless microphone for USB Type-C devices. Omnidirection built-in mic for 360-degree sound pickup, ultracompact & portable, selectable noise cancellation, automatic pairing & plug & play.

item.title: BOYA BY-V2 Wireless Microphone (Dual)
item.description: 2.4GHz wireless microphone system for iOS devices (Lightning), plug & play, live streaming without power interruption while phone charging.

item.title: BOYA BY-V20 Wireless Microphone (Dual)
item.description: 2.4GHz wireless microphone system for USB Type-C devices, plug & play, live streaming while phone charging.

item.title: BOYAMAGIC Transformable AI-Powered Mini Wireless Microphone
item.description: 4-in-1 design: Clip-On, Handheld, Desktop, On-Camera. True AI noise cancellation up to -40dB, only 7g and 13mm thin, 48kHz/24-bit 20Hz-20kHz pristine audio, limiter and safety track, 6 hrs battery life per mic (30 hrs total), one-tap pairing.

item.title: BOYA BY-K171 Microphone Boom Arm
item.description: Table microphone boom arm stand, adjustable & foldable for streaming, podcast, video gaming, recording. Smooth movement with 385mm horizontal & 340mm vertical extension, stable support, universal compatibility with condenser, dynamic & broadcast mics.

item.title: BOYA BY-BA20 Boom Arm
item.description: Versatile boom arm for desktop sound recording, perfect for radio shows, podcasts, vlogging, online meetings and gaming. Easily clamps to desktops, allows exact positioning, rugged steel alloy construction, 100-degree front-to-back movement, shockmount included.

item.title: BOYA BY-BA30 Boom Arm
item.description: Versatile boom arm for desktop sound recording, perfect for radio shows, podcasts, vlogging, online meetings and gaming. Integrated cable catch, durable C-Clamp mount, adjustable hinge control, weight capacity up to 1kg, includes 5/8-inch to 3/8-inch threading screw.

item.title: BOYA BY-BCA6 XLR to 3.5mm TRRS Connection
item.description: XLR to 3.5mm TRRS connection adapter for iPad, iPhone, iPod touch and other mobile devices. Connects XLR microphone to smartphone, no batteries required, 3-position pad (0, -10dB, -40dB), includes 3.5mm headphone output, rugged aluminum construction.

item.title: BOYA BY-BCA60 Female XLR to 3.5mm Male TRRS Microphone Audio Adapter
item.description: Connects any XLR microphones to smartphone, tablet, and laptop with a headphone/mic combo jack. Supplies 48V phantom power to microphone, delivers pristine and high-quality sound, 3.5mm headphone output for audio monitoring, 6m microphone cable.

item.title: BOYA BY-K1 Audio Adapter
item.description: 3.5mm TRS (Male) to Lightning (Male) audio adapter, secures sound intelligibility for audio recording. Allows connecting 3.5mm TRS microphone with iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch.

item.title: BOYA BY-K2 Audio Adapter
item.description: 3.5mm TRS (Male) to Type-C (Male) audio adapter for connecting 3.5mm TRS microphone with Android devices or others devices with Type-C connectors.

item.title: BOYA BY-K3 Audio Adapter
item.description: 3.5mm TRRS (Female) to Lightning (Male) audio adapter, perfect solution to connect 3.5mm TRRS microphone with iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch. Note: this is a distinct accessory from the 'BOYA K3' condenser USB microphone listed under Condenser USB Microphones.

item.title: BOYA BY-K4 Audio Adapter
item.description: 3.5mm TRS (Female) to Type-C (Male) audio adapter, specially designed for connecting 3.5mm TRS microphone with Android devices or other devices with Type-C connectors.

item.title: BOYA BY-K5 Type-C Adapter
item.description: Type-C (Male) to Type-C (Female) right angle (90 degree) adapter for flexible and reliable operation to plug a microphone into a smartphone when using a Smartphone Gimbal.

item.title: BOYA BY-CIP2 Adapter Cable for Smartphones
item.description: 3.5mm TRS Female to 3.5mm TRRS Male adapter cable, connects a TRS output microphone to the TRRS headphone jack of a smartphone or tablet.

item.title: BOYA 35C-XLR Mini-Jack to XLR Converter
item.description: Mini-Jack to XLR converter, connects a 3.5mm TRS jack microphone with an XLR input device.

item.title: BOYA BY-EA2 USB to 3.5mm Audio & Mic Adapter
item.description: USB to 3.5mm audio & mic adapter with 1x3.5mm output jack, 1x3.5mm microphone input jack, USB 2.0 Type-A interface.

item.title: BOYA BY-EA2L USB Sound Adapter
item.description: USB sound adapter compatible with Windows and Mac computers with USB 2.0 Type-A interface, includes 3.5mm headphone jack.
